mapper.sql: payment_terms.id AS id, payment_terms.payment_type_id AS typeId, payment_types.name AS typeName, payment_terms.name AS `name`, payment_terms.net_days AS netDay, payment_terms.created AS created, payment_terms.modified AS modified, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM payment_terms LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = payment_terms.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = payment_terms.modified_by LEFT JOIN payment_types ON payment_types.id = payment_terms.payment_type_id

WHERE payment_terms.is_active = 1
AND (payment_terms.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%') OR payment_types.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%'))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_terms ( payment_type_id, `name`, net_days, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{paymentTerm.typeId}, #{paymentTerm.name}, #{paymentTerm.netDay}, NOW(), #{paymentTerm.createdBy}, #{paymentTerm.isActive} )
